clips.title: The story
paras: Outside the Lakeshire Inn, Guard Berton seeks swift justice for Targorr the Dread. The human guardsman is tired of Stormwind's delays while Redridge faces the Blackrock orc invasion.

Guard Berton keeps watch outside the Lakeshire Inn as Redridge Mountains faces the Blackrock orc invasion. His concern is Targorr the Dread, an enemy captured and locked deep within the Stormwind Stockade. Sentenced to death for crimes against the kingdom, Targorr remains imprisoned because Stormwind has postponed his execution indefinitely. Berton will not let the brutal raider linger in a cell while Lakeshire bleeds. He hires willing adventurers to bypass the delays and kill the orc.
